meta.title: yokoten
meta.description: Your agent ran rm -rf. The project next door is still there. One command turns on your agent's sandbox, and it fails closed: npx yokoten.

hero.headline: Your agent ran rm -rf. Next door is still there.
hero.sub: One command turns on your agent's sandbox.

stops.label: Stop the line
stops.title: What it stops

cards.caption: A command that wipes your home folder.
A force push that throws away someone's work.
A release that only the owner should make.

stops.limit: It does not protect the folder the agent starts in. Start it in one project, not in your home folder.

firstMinute.label: Your first minute
firstMinute.title: What `npx yokoten` does
callouts: Adds the rules. Changes none of your files.

items.a: Yes. It is open source under MIT, with no account to make.

items.q: Does it send my code anywhere?
items.a: No. It runs on your machine and in your CI, with no telemetry.
Run `yokoten uninstall`; the files it added to a project are plain files you can delete.
